title: Graceful shutdown: SIGTERM drain and docs
description:
Implement clean shutdown so in-flight articles are not lost when the process is stopped.

Why this issue exists:
Both daemons exit immediately on SIGTERM, potentially losing buffered articles. Systemd and container orchestrators send SIGTERM before SIGKILL, so a clean drain is required for production deployments.

What needs to be done:
- SIGTERM/SIGINT handler and connection drain
- Flush pending IPFS writes before exit
- Hard timeout and exit codes
- Systemd and ECS deployment documentation
